visual_brief.subject: GPT-6.1 Sol cost per completed task
verified_context: OpenAI kept GPT-6.1 Sol standard input and output pricing at Sol levels while lowering cached-input pricing and reporting stronger agentic task results.
The engineering comparison is total work required to reach an accepted result, not a literal measured path length or invented chart.
Benchmark and cost-per-task comparisons remain vendor-reported and must not be visualized as precise data.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Two workflows can reach the same accepted result with very different total work.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A long winding terracotta route and a compact direct route cross the same architectural landscape toward one shared endpoint, expressing different total work for the same accepted result without literal metrics.

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant bridge-and-labyrinth metaphor with strong editorial presence, but the shared-result relationship is less immediate because the routes do not converge as clearly.
candidate_notes.B: Selected and user-approved replacement generated from the canonical Visual Constitution and Illustration System. candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant long architectural path versus short framed path. Very clear silhouette, but its stronger symmetry makes it read slightly closer to a designed comparison diagram than B.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 1600 × 900 hero crop retains the long winding route, the direct route, and their shared endpoint with comfortable negative space.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow crop keeps the direct route, enough of the winding route, and the shared endpoint visible without depending on small detail.
